audit_issue_pr_policy.description: 联网只读检查用户指定的 GitHub Issue/PR 状态及可选 PR base/head、Issue 关闭引用；适合创建 PR 前按请求范围核验。至少给 issue_number 或 pr_number；expected_base/head 仅可与 pr_number 一起使用。Issue-only 与 PR-only 均有效。只读审计本身会联网查询 GitHub；local_passed=true 表示审计符合本地策略并允许继续调用 OpenAI Decisions，local_passed=false 只阻止 OpenAI 请求，不表示此前没有查询 GitHub。顶层 passed 表示本地审计与 AI 决策均通过；同时检查 decision/ai_status/error_code。只查开放状态、显式期望的 base/head，并仅在同时给 issue_number 与 pr_number 时查 Closes/Fixes/Resolves 引用；不查 CI、labels、mergeability。只读，不修改 GitHub。若需额外只读查询且本工具未覆盖，可按共享规则使用受限 gh CLI；REST `gh api` 须显式 `--method GET`，在已知 endpoint 路径中指明 owner/repo（不是 `--repo` 选项）；GraphQL 限已审阅 query。参数、副作用不明或写入操作不适用。所有 Decisions、Responses 与输入审核 API 请求统一使用 OPENAI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=180 秒超时。仅 SDK APITimeoutError 在调用处重试；OPENAI_TIMEOUT_MAX_RETRIES 环境变量配置非负整数重试次数，未配置默认5，0关闭，空值或非法值返回 invalid_timeout_max_retries 且不发请求。不接受工具参数覆盖。默认首次加5次重试，最多6次；超时后立即串行重试，每次新建客户端并重读当前凭据和端点，SDK内部重试关闭。重试仅重发同一受检 API 请求，不重复整条工作流；其他错误不重试，耗尽返回 api_timeout。工具返回超时失败时内部预算已耗尽，Agent不再叠加整工具自动重试。重试可能产生重复API用量；MCP客户端需为多阶段审核/生成及其重试配置足够的tool_timeout_sec，180秒不代表整工具总时限。所有 OpenAI 请求经统一 httpx2.Client(trust_env=True)，每次创建客户端时读取进程环境的 HTTP_PROXY、HTTPS_PROXY、ALL_PROXY、NO_PROXY（含小写形式），不接受工具参数覆盖代理。NO_PROXY 匹配时绕过代理，未配置代理时按库默认直连；代理初始化或连接失败返回安全错误，不重试直连。Codex stdio 启动前须转发所需代理变量名；配置变更后重新加载服务，不提交或回显真实代理值。接口边界：只读 GitHub 审计会访问外部网络；仅审计通过后调用 OpenAI Decisions，审计失败只阻止 OpenAI 请求。本工具不读取宿主会话或写入 Memory。

rules_get_context.description: Local MCP tool. Load a checkpoint's legacy owner context or an explicit version-1 indexed fragment bundle. Legacy payload: node_id (registered checkpoint enum) and language (en by default; en or zh_cn). When context_version and all extension fields are omitted, return the unchanged legacy RuleContext fields, owner text, and context hash. fragment_ids and max_chars require context_version=1; unknown fields and unsupported versions fail validation. Version 1 starts with the node's indexed default fragments, adds any explicit fragment_ids, and resolves only the index's declared dependency edges in deterministic order. The response contains bounded node metadata and whole text fragments; node metadata is not charged to max_chars. max_chars counts Unicode characters in fragment text only, defaults to 12000, and is limited to 256..60000. No fragment is truncated. index_sha256 binds the canonical versioned index; context_hash binds it with node metadata, returned fragment text/hashes, the budget result, and the remaining-owner-reference report. complete=true means every requested fragment in the explicit index closure was loaded; it does not mean the task's other direct owners or linked documents have been read. remaining_owner_refs is a bounded list of local Markdown links found in returned fragments whose target section is not in the returned closure; it marks references to read separately, not rules already included. The list is capped at 16 with a truncation flag. Budget omissions and missing owner files/headings appear in missing_fragments with complete=false and an incomplete status. Invalid paths/symlinks, unknown IDs, duplicate index IDs, dependency cycles, and duplicate real headings fail closed. owner_path is repository-relative source provenance under skill/, not an installed Skill file path. Installed servers use their packaged versioned index and normalized fragments; fragment hashes cover the same trimmed text returned by either source. This read-only utility does not authenticate supplied facts or authorize execution. Correct invalid input or stop on failure.

The returned content is bounded to 64000 characters; oversized windows fail rather than silently truncate. Returns status/reason, canonical Memory/path identity, total_lines, returned_lines and the selected line range/content on success. Files are opened as UTF-8; symlinks and paths outside the local Memory folder are rejected. Project scope is fixed to the tools server's actual startup directory. The tool reads only files under that directory's .serena/memories folder, with no parent/sibling/project discovery and no installation-time project binding. It uses Python standard-library file operations only; it does not require Serena-Agent or another local program. Missing folders or files return unavailable. Rejects traversal, symlinks, non-regular files, out-of-root targets, and oversized tail windows. No files/directories, state, models or API requests are written or invoked. Missing files return unavailable. No files or directories are created, and no revision/idempotency key is used. This read-only utility does not authenticate supplied facts or authorize execution. Correct invalid input or stop on failure.

validate_decoupling_compliance.description: Local MCP tool. Run a bounded, read-only preflight over a candidate document overlay before an authorized write. Input is one JSON object in the payload envelope; output is JSON text. Payload envelope: request.policy_scope is skill_maintenance or generic_project; request.candidates has 1-64 unique entries. Each entry has a canonical repository-relative POSIX path (at most 512 characters), operation=create/replace/delete, baseline={state:absent} for create or {state:sha256,value:<64 lowercase hex>} for replace/delete, and content for create/replace. A file is limited to 131072 Unicode characters and the whole batch to 524288 UTF-8 bytes. The trusted CompliancePreflightService root and allowed policy scopes are fixed by operator startup code loaded only through --compliance-factory MODULE:CALLABLE. Payload and current working directory cannot choose a root. Without a configured reader, the tool performs no path probe and disk/baseline evidence is unknown. A disallowed scope is not evaluated. For skill_maintenance, Chinese documents are the sole authority; bilingual_mirror is not_applicable. Checks cover Markdown layer links and direct targets, and Layer-01 three-section structure when applicable. The overlay covers all submitted candidates. generic_project returns not_applicable for Skill-maintenance checks. The implementation never imports or executes candidate-repository scripts. Returns overall status fail/unknown/pass/not_applicable, policy_version=1, bounded per-rule check objects with rule_id, path/line/reason evidence, and an explicit evidence_missing list, limits, and not_evaluated entries. Unknown checks name the missing evidence; other checks use an empty list. Overall precedence is fail, then unknown, then pass; not_applicable checks do not mask active results. Link-target and output-check limits turn omitted evidence into unknown. This is a read-only lookup: no target file writes, API request, subprocess, reverse inbound-link scan, proof of semantic correctness, or full CI run. Unknown means the relevant disk evidence could not be safely verified; correct scope, baseline, path, reader configuration, or budget issues and rerun against current content. This read-only utility does not authenticate supplied facts or authorize execution. Correct invalid input or stop on failure.
